title: Console CSV downloads built in the browser have no UTF-8 byte-order mark, so Excel shows non-ASCII text garbled
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kgF3mo9f7LXuv5hac

Filing gate: ① (named locations; carrier for item R1 of L1 6921943962 on PR #34357, the "Not changed here" list in that PR's Acceptance notes).

**Where (origin/main):** five Console writers build a CSV file in the browser and download it without a leading UTF-8 byte-order mark:
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5886` (the client-side fallback export of a list view)
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:1617` (grid export, csv format)
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx:2309` (data table export)
- `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExportEngine.ts:54` (report csv export)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/IdentityImportPanels.tsx:87` (temporary-password csv after an identity import)

**Behaviour (read, not run):** each joins rows with `','` and `'\n'` and hands the text to a `Blob` typed `text/csv` (three say `charset=utf-8`). No writer prepends the mark. Excel picks the system code page for a CSV with no mark, so Chinese (or any non-ASCII) names and values open garbled. This is the same defect #34163 fixes for the server export `GET /api/v1/data/:object/export` (PR #34357). The Console's server export path saves that body with `res.blob()`, so it gets the fix; these five files are built client-side and do not.

**Suggestion:** one shared helper that prepends the mark (written as the escape `﻿`) once, used by all five writers, with a byte-level test per writer. The csv import already strips one leading mark (`packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts:49`), so a Console file fed back to import still parses.

**Business reason:** customers who export from the Console in Chinese open the file in Excel and see mojibake; the server-side fix alone leaves the most-used buttons broken.

**Reader who acts:** triage first-touches domain (ui) and grade; the ui lane builds it.

**Dedupe:** searched open issues for "csv BOM" and "csv excel utf-8": only #34163 (server export) matches.
